decisions.transports: compiled CLI via `node bin/bb tool bb_edit --dir <root> --args <json>`; MCP via StdioClientTransport → src/mcp/server.ts (Bun runs server.ts directly, Node uses bin/bb mcp)
decisions.dryRun: every positive case uses dryRun:true so no file is written; a separate check confirms the target file does NOT exist after a dry-run write
decisions.modeAwareIndexGate: runs its own leg against the SOURCE MCP server (`--import tsx --input-type=module -e`) on a project with no index: a compiled bundle would answer about whatever it was built from, and the claim under test is the gate in the tree

limitations: The CLI transport reads the prebuilt bin/bb; run `npm run build` before this verifier.
MCP stdio under Bun executes src/mcp/server.ts directly (no build needed for that path).
